errorContractReview.capabilityAndPermission: The owned authenticated SDK client exercised the recorded handler paths. Unauthorized clients and broader capability/permission outcomes remain untested; absence of a request parameter does not make them inapplicable.
errorContractReview.conflict: The four methods expose no expected revision or mutation binding. Preview reports stale selection structurally; upgrade and refresh resolve their named targets at execution; checkNow rechecks eligibility under lock.
errorContractReview.disconnect: Explicitly untested for these plugin mutations. A disconnect after dispatch can leave acknowledgement uncertain; no method-specific idempotency key is exposed. No injection mechanism is assumed to be required. Authoritative list, browse and effect readback remain the observed-state checks, without a qualified lost-acknowledgement recovery claim.
